learning.objective: Recall the alphabet sequence and write missing uppercase letters.
learning.instruction: Say each letter row. Write the missing letters.
learning.expected_response: B, G, L, Q, V and Y written in six alphabet sequences.
learning.child_thinking: I say the alphabet in order and listen for the letter that is missing.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say each short sequence and pause at the blank without giving the missing letter.

teaching_gates: one large writing box per row

learning.objective: Match uppercase letters to their lowercase forms.
learning.instruction: Draw a line from each uppercase letter to its lowercase letter.
learning.expected_response: Six lines matching B-b, D-d, G-g, M-m, R-r and T-t.
learning.child_thinking: The two letters look different but have the same name.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name one uppercase letter and ask the child to find the lowercase letter with the same name.

learning.objective: Connect familiar consonants with pictures that begin with their sounds.
learning.instruction: Say each sound. Draw a line to the picture that begins with it.
learning.expected_response: m-moon, s-sun, t-tiger and p-pen.
learning.child_thinking: I say the sound, name each picture, and listen to its first sound.

guidance.teacher_cue: Stretch each beginning sound once, then let the child name and match the picture.

learning.objective: Identify the beginning sound of familiar picture words.
learning.instruction: Name each picture. Circle its beginning letter.
learning.expected_response: c for cat, f for fish, s for sun and p for pen.
learning.child_thinking: I say the word slowly and listen to the first sound.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to say the picture name before looking at the two letters.

teaching_gates: two large letter choices per card

learning.objective: Identify the ending sound of familiar CVC words.
learning.instruction: Name each picture. Circle its ending letter.
learning.expected_response: t for cat, g for dog, n for sun, s for bus, p for cap and n for hen.
learning.child_thinking: I stretch the word and listen to the last sound.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say the whole word, then repeat it slowly and emphasise only the last sound.

teaching_gates: two large letter choices per card
no answer circle in independent cards
each word has a clear final consonant

learning.objective: Match familiar words that rhyme.
learning.instruction: Name each picture. Draw a line to the picture that rhymes.
learning.expected_response: dog-log, sun-run, cake-snake and star-car.
learning.child_thinking: Rhyming words have the same ending sound.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name both pictures in a pair and repeat their ending sounds together.

teaching_gates: each intended picture name is unambiguous

learning.objective: Find pictures with the same beginning sound as a model picture.
learning.instruction: Name the first picture. Circle the picture with the same beginning sound.
learning.expected_response: milk, ring, lamp, gift and vase selected in five rows.
learning.child_thinking: I compare the first sound in each picture name.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say the model picture and both choices slowly, listening only to the first sound.

learning.objective: Identify the picture whose beginning sound differs from the others.
learning.instruction: Name the three pictures. Circle the one with a different beginning sound.
learning.expected_response: bus, cat, sun, chair and hat selected in five rows.
learning.child_thinking: Two words begin alike; one begins differently.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask which two words begin alike before asking which picture is different.

learning.objective: Read familiar consonant-vowel-consonant words and match them to pictures.
learning.instruction: Read each word. Draw a line to the correct picture.
learning.expected_response: cat, dog, sun and pen matched to their pictures.
learning.child_thinking: I blend the three sounds and find the picture that names the word.

guidance.teacher_cue: Point under each letter while the child blends the three sounds into one word.

teaching_gates: model word is not reused in the task

learning.objective: Arrange three letter sounds to build familiar CVC words.
learning.instruction: Name the picture. Read the letter cards. Write the word in the boxes.
learning.expected_response: cat, sun, dog and pen written in four three-box rows.
learning.child_thinking: I listen for the first, middle and last sound in the word.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say the picture name slowly and ask for the first, middle and last sound in order.

learning.objective: Read and recognise words for familiar objects.
learning.instruction: Read each word. Draw a line to the correct picture.
learning.expected_response: house, tree, book, chair and flower matched to their pictures.
learning.child_thinking: I read the word and find the picture with that name.

guidance.teacher_cue: Let the child attempt each word before naming any picture.

learning.objective: Recognise familiar action words in pictures.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture. Circle the action word that matches.
learning.expected_response: run, jump, eat and sleep selected.
learning.child_thinking: I notice what the person is doing and choose the word that names the action.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask what the child in each picture is doing before reading the choices.

learning.objective: Match familiar words and pictures with opposite meanings.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture. Draw a line to its opposite.
learning.expected_response: big-small, full-empty, hot-cold, open-closed, clean-dirty and happy-sad.
learning.child_thinking: I name the first idea and find the picture that means the reverse.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name the idea shown on the left, then ask which picture shows the opposite idea.

teaching_gates: paired pictures differ in only the intended concept

learning.objective: Choose a familiar describing word for each picture.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture. Circle the word that describes it.
learning.expected_response: soft, tall, red and happy selected.
learning.child_thinking: I notice colour, size, feeling or texture and choose the word that fits.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to describe the picture aloud before reading the two choices.

teaching_gates: each picture supports one unambiguous adjective

learning.objective: Classify familiar pictures as fruits, animals or vehicles.
learning.instruction: Look at each numbered picture. Write its number in the correct group.
learning.expected_response: Fruits: 1,4,7; Animals: 2,5,8; Vehicles: 3,6,9.
learning.child_thinking: I name the picture, decide its group, and record its number.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name the three groups, then let the child classify each numbered picture.

learning.objective: Read simple words and match each word to its picture.
learning.instruction: Read each word. Draw a line to the correct picture.
learning.expected_response: Seven lines matching cat, sun, bus, cup, pen, dog and hen.
learning.child_thinking: I sound out the word and find the picture with that name.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to sound out each word before drawing the matching line.

teaching_gates: main and reinforcement activities both present

learning.objective: Read short colour instructions and apply them to familiar outline pictures.
learning.instruction: Read each sentence. Colour the picture as it says.
learning.expected_response: Red apple, blue ball, yellow sun and green leaf.
learning.child_thinking: I read the colour word and use that colour on the named picture.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to point to the colour word before choosing a crayon.

learning.objective: Read two familiar words and select the word that names a picture.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture. Read the words. Circle the correct word.
learning.expected_response: cat, cup, bus and hen selected.
learning.child_thinking: I name the picture, read both words, and choose the matching word.

guidance.teacher_cue: Let the child read both words before deciding which one matches the picture.

learning.objective: Arrange familiar words to build a short sentence and copy it.
learning.instruction: Look at the picture. Number the word cards in order. Copy the sentence.
learning.expected_response: Three correctly ordered and copied sentences.
learning.child_thinking: I decide who or what comes first, then what happens.

guidance.teacher_cue: Read the shuffled cards aloud, then ask which word begins the sentence.

teaching_gates: one purposeful copy line per row
no completed sentence in independent rows

learning.objective: Choose and write a familiar word that completes a short sentence.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture. Circle the correct word and write it in the blank.
learning.expected_response: cat, hot, run and book written in four sentence blanks.
learning.child_thinking: I read the sentence and choose the word that makes sense with the picture.

guidance.teacher_cue: Read the sentence up to the blank, then let the child test both choices aloud.

learning.objective: Read a controlled picture scene and answer simple questions from visual evidence.
learning.instruction: Look carefully at the picture. Circle the correct answer to each question.
learning.expected_response: Four answers selected from one park scene.
learning.child_thinking: I look for the person, object or place named in the question.

asset_meanings.park_scene: one uncluttered park scene with a girl holding a red ball, a boy beside a bench, a dog under a tree and a blue kite above the tree

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to point to the visual evidence before choosing an answer.

teaching_gates: all answers are visible in the scene

learning.objective: Listen to a familiar word and select its picture.
learning.instruction: Listen to the teacher. Circle the picture that matches the word.
learning.expected_response: Four pictures selected after the teacher says cat, pen, dog and hat.
learning.child_thinking: I listen to the whole word, then find the picture with that name.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say each target word once naturally and once slowly; do not point or repeat the answer.

learning.objective: Answer who, what and where questions about a simple picture.
learning.instruction: Look at the picture. Read each question. Circle the correct answer.
learning.expected_response: Four correct answers selected from one reading scene.
learning.child_thinking: I find the clue in the picture and choose the answer that makes sense.

asset_meanings.reading_scene: one girl reading a red book on a blue mat beside a small dog, under a tree

guidance.teacher_cue: Have the child point to the clue in the picture before reading both answer choices.

teaching_gates: questions are answerable from the scene

learning.objective: Recognise common sight words in short sentences.
learning.instruction: Read each sentence. Circle the word shown in the star.
learning.expected_response: see, the, a and is circled once in four sentences.
learning.child_thinking: I remember the sight word and find the same word in the sentence.

guidance.teacher_cue: Read the target word first, then track the sentence from left to right.

teaching_gates: target appears exactly once per sentence

learning.objective: Review word reading, rhyme, sentence meaning and sight-word recognition.
learning.instruction: Complete each reading challenge.
learning.expected_response: One response in each of six review panels.
learning.child_thinking: I use sounds, words and picture clues to solve each task.

guidance.teacher_cue: Give one direction at a time and allow the child to complete each panel independently.

teaching_gates: six different but related review tasks
all circles and ticks remain open

learning.objective: Order four pictures to show a familiar event sequence.
learning.instruction: Look at the pictures. Write 1, 2, 3 and 4 to show the correct order.
learning.expected_response: Numbers 1-4 written under four shuffled tooth-brushing scenes.
learning.child_thinking: I decide what happens first, next and last.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask what must happen first before discussing the middle and final scenes.

learning.objective: Retell a four-step story using picture cues and sequence words.
learning.instruction: Point to each picture. Tell the story using first, next, then and last.
learning.expected_response: An oral retelling of a seed-growing story in four steps.

model_text.starter: First, the child opens the book.

learning.child_thinking: I follow the pictures in order and say what happens at each step.

asset_meanings.plant_seed: child plants a seed in soil

guidance.teacher_cue: Point to one scene at a time and prompt only with the printed sequence word.

teaching_gates: scenes are already in correct order

learning.objective: Speak in complete short sentences about a social picture.
learning.instruction: Look at the picture. Take turns asking and answering the questions.
learning.expected_response: Three oral answers and one partner question about a playground scene.
learning.child_thinking: I notice what the children are doing, listen to my partner and answer clearly.

prompts.question: How does the waiting child feel?

mechanics.partner_turn_cue: Ask one question. Listen to your partner's answer.

asset_meanings.playground_conversation: two children sharing a ball near a slide while a third child waits to join

guidance.teacher_cue: Let partners ask and answer one prompt at a time, then switch roles.

learning.objective: Answer who, what and where questions from one picture.
learning.instruction: Look at the picture. Circle the answer to each question.
learning.expected_response: Girl, reading and under the tree selected.
learning.child_thinking: Who asks about a person, what asks about an action or object, and where asks about a place.

asset_meanings.girl_reading_tree: one girl reading a book under a tree with a dog nearby

guidance.teacher_cue: Say who, what or where first, then read the corresponding question.

learning.objective: Draw and describe a favourite story character.
learning.instruction: Draw your favourite story character. Complete the sentence below.
learning.expected_response: One purposeful drawing and an adult-supported character name.

model_text.sentence: My favourite character is the rabbit.

learning.child_thinking: I remember a character, draw important details and say why I like the character.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to name one detail in the drawing and record the child's words if needed.

learning.objective: Demonstrate beginning and ending sounds, rhyme and CVC word reading.
learning.instruction: Complete each activity by yourself.
learning.expected_response: One answer in each of four independent assessment panels.

model_text.note: No worked answer; teacher reads the four directions only.

learning.child_thinking: I use the sound and word strategies I have practised.

guidance.teacher_cue: Read each direction once and record support separately without indicating an answer.

learning.objective: Demonstrate sight-word recognition, sentence meaning, sequencing and picture comprehension.
learning.instruction: Complete each activity by yourself.
learning.expected_response: One answer in each of four independent assessment panels.

model_text.note: No worked answer; teacher reads the four directions only.

learning.child_thinking: I read carefully, look for clues and record one answer for each task.

asset_meanings.girl_reads: one girl reading under a tree

guidance.teacher_cue: Give only the printed directions and allow quiet independent response time.

learning.objective: Review the main letter, sound, word, sentence and story skills in the book.
learning.instruction: Complete the six literacy challenges.
learning.expected_response: Six short responses covering the book's core skills.
learning.child_thinking: I choose the strategy that fits each challenge.

guidance.teacher_cue: Invite the child to complete one challenge at a time and explain one chosen answer.

teaching_gates: model skill is not repeated as an independent answer

learning.objective: Celebrate completion of Early Literacy Adventures.
learning.instruction: This certifies that the learner has completed Early Literacy Adventures.
learning.expected_response: Adult writes the learner's name, date and signature in deterministic fields.
learning.child_thinking: I can celebrate the literacy skills I practised.

asset_meanings.badge: one celebratory reading badge with a book and star, without words
asset_meanings.book_cluster: small celebratory cluster of books, letters and stars

guidance.teacher_cue: Present the certificate after the learner completes the review pages.

teaching_gates: logo and certificate text are deterministic
no generated readable text in artwork

learning.objective: Reflect on confidence with letters, words and short sentences.
learning.instruction: Look at each statement. Tick what you can do and tell your teacher one example.
learning.expected_response: Three self-reflection ticks and one oral example.
learning.child_thinking: I notice what I can do now and share one example.

statements: I can talk about a story.
mechanics.oral_prompt: Show or tell one thing you can read.

asset_meanings.reader_hero: one confident LKG child reading a picture book with a small stack of books and letter blocks

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask for one example after the child chooses a statement; accept oral reading or supported response.

learning.objective: Celebrate favourite literacy learning from the book.
learning.instruction: Choose your favourite literacy activity. Draw or write one example.
learning.expected_response: One selected activity and one purposeful drawing or short written example.
learning.child_thinking: I remember what I enjoyed and show one thing I learned.

mechanics.work_frame_prompt: Draw or write your example here.

asset_meanings.celebration_hero: three diverse LKG children celebrating with books, alphabet blocks and picture cards, no text

guidance.teacher_cue: Let the child choose one area and describe the drawing or written example.

teaching_gates: celebration art does not dominate the response area
